title: S7 governed handover schema reference
test_intent: Determine whether structured asset or lifecycle handover deliverables reference an identifiable governed schema and version with a validation and exception route rather than relying on an undocumented field list.

applicability.applies_when: The handover scope includes an asset register, COBie-like dataset, equipment schedule, O&M/lifecycle dataset, or another structured lifecycle deliverable.
applicability.not_applicable_when: The tested handover scope contains no structured asset or lifecycle dataset.

result_logic.pass: Every applicable structured lifecycle deliverable references a governed schema and version with traceable validation and exception handling.
result_logic.fail: An applicable lifecycle deliverable is produced or accepted against an undocumented, unversioned, or untraceable schema basis.
result_logic.not_applicable: No structured asset/lifecycle dataset is required in the tested handover scope.
result_logic.indeterminate: The project handover requirement exists but the governing schema catalogue entry or authoritative schema artifact is unavailable.

provenance.migration_note: Derived from GAP-S7-02 source scaffold. This test checks governed schema reference and versioning, not completeness against any proprietary client field list that is not present in the repository.
